title: SSL Certificate Errors, Decoded: Fix Each One by the Message You See
linkedin:
Read the exact error code.

A date error means the certificate expired, so renew it (and auto-renew so it can't happen again). A name error means the cert doesn't cover the hostname you're visiting. "Unable to verify the first certificate" means a missing intermediate, so install the full chain.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/fix-ssl-certificate-errors/
